## What's Changed (since v0.1.1)

### 🚀 Features
- on-device detection review via shared ClusterUtils 
- Address PR review feedback on ADB timeout handling and CLI subshell logic
- Audit codebase and implement comprehensive improvements across all modules

### 🧹 Chores
- bump gradle-wrapper from 9.5.1 to 9.6.0 (deps)
- bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 (deps)

___
### 📥 Requirements
| | |
|---|---|
| **Root** | Magisk / KernelSU / APatch / SuperSU |
| **Framework** | LSPosed (recommended) – or Overlay Mode (no framework) |
| **Android** | 6.0+ (API 23) |
| **Version Code** | 200 |
